Shifted for AM cleaning. Dog was laying on bed, soft face, wagging tail. Handler opened gate, dog readily approached and allowed easy leash placement. Dog walked loose leash, allowed all petting, entered outside kennel with light direction, allowed leash removal by hand.
11/21/2026
Dog did not eat food from previous day of kibble and canned food will offer treats at 2nd feed today to entice eating.
11/19/2026
Soft face, tail wagging, appeared slightly timid but softened with coaxing and readily approached front of kennel. Sniffed hand, accepted treats.
11/17/2026

11/12/2026
Dog was lying down on kuranda bed, would quickly retreat to back half of kennel while having tail tightly tucked under body, ears pinned back & low growling.  Closed kennel divider & approached back half of kennel.  Dog would stand @ kennel gate with weight shifted evenly, growling while baring teeth, ears pinned back & whale eyed.  Offered treats, would not be interested in treats.  Opened gate & presented leash, dog would walk backwards slowly to divider.  Used a large loop leash to cast towards dog, dog would do a false lunge forward while growling & air snapping towards leash.  Handler would reset & cast again, dog would catch leash in mouth while growling, did an intense stare then dropped leash from mouth while shifting weight evenly again having furrow brows, curling lips & continuing to growl.  Handler would reset again & able to secure leash placement.  Walked out of kennel while having hackles raised, head lowered & ears still pinned back.  Did a shake off of body & continued to walk to small PY without issues while relaxing hackles & head/ears.  Handler would drop leash & dog would start to explore with nose to ground.  Approached handler, placing front paws onto handlers knees & allowed petting.  Offered treats, would sniff treats but not interested in treats.  Started to do zoomies.  Would be interested in sniffing toys & chasing a tennis ball.  Jumped up onto bench & would lean into handler while being pet.  Curious of people walking past PY then returning back to kennel with a fast tail wag, allowing more petting.  Picked up leash & walked to a new kennel building.  Entered into kennel as handler would toss a soft toy inside kennel.  Came forward to front gate & allowed leash removal to be done slowly by hand.
11/11/2026
Dogd did not eat from previous day amy have canned food alredy added will add in treats to 2nd fed today to entyce eating.
11/11/2026
Laying on bed with stiff body, wide eyed, low growling at handler, trembling in back legs, no interest in treats offered or tossed near, closed divider. Wary of leash, slow pacing in back of kennel with pilo-erection and low growling  but able to slowly approach and place leash with no issues as dog would turn head away from leash, hesistant to exit kennel, startled and skiddish of loud noises in room, darted out of kennel then settled to easy leash pull, wary of surroundings, no issues walking to small play yard. In yard dog had no reaction to brushing leash on back, began exploring with neutral body and tucked tail, took interest in toy and sniffed/lightly played with toy but easily startled and redirected attention elsewhere, was distant from handler for first couple moments until dog came running towards handler sitting on bench and jumped up onto handler, wide eyed, tail started to wag and dog softened when petted while sitting in handlers lap, started to become more wiggly when interacting with handler. No issues getting dog off of lap, would have some playful energy towards handler, wagging tail and softer body when using squeaky toy, would jump up onto handler for attentions and accept pets all over, stayed close to handler remainder of evaluation. No reaction towards clip leash being placed once leash was recovered. Easy return to kennel, no issues on walk back, entered kennel on own and used clip leash for leash retrieval.
11/5/2026
Dog did not eat from previous day will add in 2tbs canned food to entyce eating.
11/3/2026
Dog came in crate. Dog allowed handler to leash through crate and pull bed out while dog was laying on it. Handler was able to place muzzle on dog and restrain dog for vaccines. Dog allowed handler to carry to kennel.

The patient was found to be unilaterally cryptorchid (R testicle descended; L testicle abdominally-retained).  An approximate 3cm incision was made along the R lateral aspect of the prepuce.  The incision was then extended into the abdomen via the linea alba.  A spay hook was used to locate the intra-abdominal L testicle.   The L testicle was exteriorized from the abdomen.  The spermatic cord was ligated with a strangle knot using 2-0 webmax and then transected with a Mayo scissor; the L testicle was removed.  The linea alba was closed with cruciate sutures using 2-0 webmax.  The continuous subcutaneous/ intradermal layer was closed with 2-0 webmax.  A pre-scrotal incision was then made.  The R testicle was exteriorized.  The spermatic cord was ligated with a strangle knot using 3-0 webmax and then transected with a Mayo scissor; the R testicle was removed.  The continuous subcutaneous/ intradermal layer was closed with 3-0 webmax.   Skin glue was applied to the incisions.  Green tattoo was etched.

11/21/2026
Assisted with shifting dog for AM cleaning. Dog was standing over toy and blanket, hard staring and lip curling at handler. Handler tossed treats outside, dog ignored treats and continued growling and lip curling at handler, rushed to kennel door when trying to place leash, handler blocked dog from exiting, dog retreated back to toy and continued growling, snapped at leash, took a few attempts to place, dog then quickly exited kennel, walked dog to back half, dog began fence fighting with neighbor, able to redirect and guide into kennel, used clip leash.
11/20/2026
Dog would not shift outside for AM cleaning. On approach, dog was laying at front of kennel, stiff body, hard-staring up at handler. Dog began growling, stood and bared teeth, lunged up towards hand every time handler attempted to open gate. Handler spoke softly, shook treat bag. Dog immediately softened, wagged tail. Handler was able to toss treats through divider, dog followed them outside.
11/18/2026
Dog was lying on bed, ears pinned, averted gaze, lip curled as handler tried coaxing forward, would not approach. Dog then stood and grabbed nearby toy, returned to bed and sat facing away from handler. Ate hot dogs tossed on bed, able coax forward with treat trail, dog softened with wagging tail, retreated back to bed when presented with leash, able to reach in and place leash with large loop, dog grabbed leash briefly, no issues walking to yard, showed no interest in kenneled dogs. Dog was affiliative with handler, high energy, soft body and wagging tail, front paws on lap, allowed petting all over, jumped up towards face, ears pinned, eyes wide, quick, erratic movements, handler stood, dog continued to jump on handler, able to redirect into sit for treats, took gently from hand. Able to pick up leash and walk back to kennel, easy return, dog pulled back and bit hand while removing leash, made contact but no marks.
11/17/2026
While completing a walk through, dog was on back, belly up when handler briefly approached kennel front. When directly in front of kennel dog's body became tense, eyes became wide showing whites, while lip licking and lip curling at handler. When handler walked away from kennel, dog became relaxed again with soft eyes, stopped lip licking and lip curling, and continued to lay on back with belly up. When handler re-approached kennel front and bent down to be on dogs level, to try and observe behavior once more, dog again, tensed body (while still laying on back), started lip licking and lip curling again, with wide eyes, hard stare and whites in the eyes. Handler did not hear any growling or low growling. Once handler got up and disengaged with dog and moved away from front of kennel, dogs body went back to a neutral body, stopped lip licking and lip curling, and softened eyes with no whites.
11/15/2026
Social / Approaches easily, Easy / Cooperative, Took on walkpath, Easy / Loose leash, Moderate pull on leash, Low energy, Social / Affiliative, Affectionate towards handler, Accepted pets, Easy return, Food motivated, Interested in toys, Tail wagging, soft body, affectionate, good girl.
11/13/2026
Dog did not eat food form previous day already on kibble and canend food will add in treats to entyce eating at 2nd feed today.
11/13/2026
Soft and wiggly, easy leashing, strong pull, jumpy, allowed all handling and vaccine booster with mild muzzle wrap restraint, tensed body during restraint, easy kennel return, easy leash removal by hand.
11/4/2026
Dog would approached kennel gate with a soft tail wag.  Allowed leash placement without issues.  Walked with a moderate pull on leash to main PY.  Would explore with a high tail wag while sniffing nose to ground.  Would approach handler on own & when called over.  Not interested in treats or toys.  Would run & jump up against handler then start to do zoomies.  Had brief moments of looking towards handler while freezing body posture then run off to do more zoomies.  Allowed petting without issues.  Would maintain high energy while exploring, jumping up against handler & return to running.  Able to call dog over & pick up leash.  Walked back to kennel while jumping up on leash, able to keep walking forward.  Would not enter into kennel on own, would follow handler inside, able to step out of kennel & remove leash by hand.
